headline: US Sanctions Iranian Oil Traders and Government-Linked Export Facilitators
summary: The US Treasury Department enacted new sanctions targeting Iranian petroleum traders and facilitators under Operation Economic Outcast to disrupt Iran's illicit oil export revenue.
why: US economic sanctions on Iranian petroleum entities aim to constrain global trade flows of sanctioned crude.

impacts.name: Iran
impacts.why: The US Treasury targeted Iranian oil trading networks with new sanctions.
